method: actual bomber component redrawn and inspected before reassembly
prompt:
Use case: combined mecha assembly design refinement. Draw ONE coherent full-body Social Brave King robot on plain warm ivory, a generously framed square 1536x1536 composition so BOTH WHOLE aircraft wings, crown, giant fists and feet are fully visible with empty margins. No effects, labels or poster background.

Image 1 is the CONTROLLING bomber component architecture. Image 2 v17 shows the required concept of that entire bomber installed over the upper robot body as a thick wide shoulder-and-chest airframe. Image 3 R2 is the approved humanoid identity and KINETIC_CEL rendering, actual giant fists, train-shell forearm attachments, orange/ivory paint, mane and tracked drilling legs. Its narrow torso and tiny train-like shoulder winglets MUST BE REPLACED by the full aircraft component in image 1, not retained. Image 4 controls the tall head-to-body and leg proportions only.

The most important change: actually INTEGRATE the bomber's broad center fuselage, large swept wings and engine frame across the torso/back. Show the full heavy flying-wing planform: very substantial swept triangular wing surfaces with wide chord, visible upper surfaces, trailing-edge flaps and thick integrated wing roots extending from the broad chest to BOTH sides. The bomber's low graphite dorsal center-body lies behind the neck and shoulders. Its one glazed orange wedge cockpit/nose forms the chest center. There are two upper air intakes and visible underslung engine nacelles carried by this upper-body frame. Preserve an uninterrupted aircraft fuselage-and-wing structure; it must read as the same bomber as image 1, now worn by the robot. NO train carriage windows, door panels, narrow sword-like winglets, isolated shoulder pads, or extra cockpit noses on the chest. Only the central aircraft cockpit has glass; train windows belong ONLY to the existing train half-shells beside the forearms.

The torso underneath is thick and powerful: broad/deep ribcage, wide stout armored abdomen, strong waist and braced shoulder joints, substantially more massive than image 3. Do not make a skinny wasp waist. Keep a tall heroic humanoid with long legs; do not revert to v17's squat toy proportions. Add the body volume in torso width/depth, not by shortening legs.

The combined head must clearly UPGRADE the uncombined Brave Fist core. Use v17's fierce authoritative feel, retaining cyan eyes and the orange-white mane but adding a distinct heavier layered crown/helmet: a taller central orange crest on broad silver brow armor, stepped silver/orange corona plates at temples, substantial cheek shields and a deep collar. A wider, more commanding mechanical head than image 3's two simple long antenna horns. Not just the same head recolored. Symmetrical architecture in perspective, no organic lion muzzle, no iconic Gundam mouth slits or red chin.

Keep BOTH physically enormous real closed fists from image 3, big knuckle and finger blocks, thick wrists and reinforced cylindrical forearms. The hands remain visibly larger than the head. Existing undersea-train half-shells are external forearm additions, cab ends aimed to the rear/elbows, sides opened alongside the hands; the front actual fists remain unobscured. No whole train car on shoulders. Lower legs retain external tracks and forward knee drills, broad feet. All arms and legs connect coherently.

Strong braced ready stance, mild front three-quarter low camera, whole body and all wing tips fit inside the square. Keep the approved illustration style of image 3: clean hand-drawn mecha animation, hard flat orange/ivory/graphite color masses and crisp restrained cel shadows, minimal weathering. Bomber top surfaces may retain more graphite to keep aircraft identity, surrounded by ivory leading edges and orange accents; don't wash the whole robot gray. ONE robot; no separate floating aircraft, no duplicate upper body, no aura.
